description: Create a new SLD style named 'area_classification' in the 'ne' workspace. This style must use the OGC 'area' function to dynamically calculate the area of the geometry. Configure two rules: 1) Features with an area LESS THAN 15.0 square degrees should have a RED fill (#FF0000). 2) Features with an area GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO 15.0 square degrees should have a GRAY fill (#AAAAAA). Apply this style as the default style for the 'ne:ne_countries' layer. Finally, generate a map preview image (800x400 PNG) of the layer showing the global extent (-180,-90,180,90) and save it to '/home/ga/area_map.png'.
